modoConversao.Dica: Automatic: detects the scene unit (m, ft, km, mi...). Manual: always uses the factor below.

fatorManual.Dica: Used in manual mode or when the scene unit is not recognized. E.g. 1 if the scene is in meters; 0.3048 for feet.

modoMedicao.Dica: Center to center, or nearest edge to nearest edge (better for large creatures).

incluirElevacao.Dica: Includes the elevation difference between tokens (3D distance).

mostrarAoPassar.Dica: With a token selected, shows the distance above the hovered token.

Atalho.Dica: Whispers you the distances from the selected token to targeted tokens (or all visible tokens).

Avisos.SemOrigem: Select a token to measure distances.
Avisos.SemAlvos: No other visible tokens to measure.
